newer_changes_search: Read the GO of 23 May 2025 pp. 1-2 as images (hash matched): native guardian, ₹3 lakh, ages 18 and 21, ₹60,000 + ₹25,000 + ₹15,000. Press reports agree with ₹1 lakh. Budget 2026-27 highlights say ₹1.01 lakh, with no order found for that figure.

findings.note: Budget highlights say ₹1.01 lakh while the GO and department page add up to ₹1,00,000. The file follows the GO, which is the stronger source, and the source note records this.
findings.suggestion: Update if a newer GO appears.

findings.note: GO (v) also covers abandoned women (परित्यक्ता) with a legal separation, and (vii) gives priority to some groups.
The GO says the guardian must be a native of UP, stricter than 'Lives in Uttar Pradesh'.
